messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":14,"verses":[{"chapter":14,"text":"For your law has been burned, therefore no one knows the things that are done by you, or the works that will be done.","verse":21},{"chapter":14,"text":"But if I have found favor before you, send the Holy Spirit to me, and I will write all that has been done in the world since the beginning, even the things that were written in your law, that men may be able to find the path, and that those who would live in the latter days may live.â€‌","verse":22},{"chapter":14,"text":"He answered me and said, â€œGo your way, gather the people together, and tell them not to seek you for forty days.","verse":23},{"chapter":14,"text":"But prepare for yourself many tablets, and take with you Sarea, Dabria, Selemia, Ethanus, and Asiel, these five, which are ready to write swiftly;","verse":24},{"chapter":14,"text":"and come here, and I will light a lamp of understanding in your heart which will not be put out until the things have ended about which you will write.","verse":25}],"book_code":"2ES"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 21,22,23,24,25 in this chapter.
